# Vesture — Your Personal AI Stylist & Digital Wardrobe

> Vesture is an intelligent digital wardrobe app and personal AI stylist designed for everyday life. It helps anyone catalog their real closet, get tailored daily outfit recommendations based on occasion and weather, track cost-per-wear analytics, and build versatile capsule rotations.

## Core Features
- **Visual Closet Cataloging**: Snap or upload photos of your real clothes. Automatic background removal isolates garments into clean digital assets categorized by slot, color, season, and formality.
- **Weather-Aware AI Stylist**: Recommends personalized outfit combinations tailored to local temperature, weather conditions, and daily schedule (office, casual coffee, night out, travel).
- **Fitpic Logger & Calendar**: Visual calendar to track what you wore every day and discover your true cost-per-wear metrics.
- **Capsule Wardrobe Multiplier**: Build high-efficiency capsule wardrobes with 10x outfit combinations from minimal core items.
